intro: Zarrin is a night elf culinary mentor located in Dolanaar on the boughs of Teldrassil. Tending an open hearth behind the village inn, he instructs young night elves and visitors in traditional Kaldorei cooking techniques.

p: Situated behind the Dolanaar inn away from the main thoroughfare, Zarrin tends an open fire where he shares the culinary arts of the Kaldorei. Survival in Teldrassil requires utilizing the native flora and fauna of the giant tree, and Zarrin serves as an instructor for those seeking to sustain themselves through foraging and home-cooked meals.
